# XingAI Passive Income Idea

> Daily one-Idea passive income research report for a defined operator profile. Email Summary + A4 PDF. Informational only — not financial advice.

- Product: https://passive.xingai.app/
- Primary flow: read today’s Idea → 30-minute action → optional PDF/email when worker is live
- Languages: en, zh, ko
- Disclaimer: suggestions only; no income guarantees; separate investment returns vs business revenue
